title: ClickEvent
description: Topic `clicks` (12 partitions). Kafka key (UTF-8): `<ad_id>` for normal ads, `<ad_id>#<salt>` for hot ads (spec §5.1.1), so a hot ad spreads over partitions. Value = this JSON object (UTF-8, no envelope). Produced by click-receiver with acks=all + idempotence, only for accepted (non-duplicate) clicks. Consumed by the click-aggregator Flink job (group `click-aggregator`), which aggregates by (ad_id, salt, minute) then (ad_id, minute).

click_id.description: Generated by the receiver per request; also returned as X-Click-Id.

advertiser_id.description: From the receiver's ad lookup; lets the aggregator write per-advertiser rows without a join.

salt.description: 0 for non-hot ads; random 0..HOT_SALT_BUCKETS-1 for hot ads. Equals the suffix of the Kafka key when salted.

clicked_at.description: Event time: when the receiver accepted the click, UTC, RFC 3339 with millisecond precision and a trailing Z, e.g. 2026-09-26T12:00:01.123Z. The minute bucket is derived from this.

receiver.description: pod@node of the receiver that accepted the click (debugging / zone experiments).
